name: label
description: Field label with an optional required marker. Consumed by input-field, select-field and combobox-field; the parent field owns the state.

label.purpose: Label text plus the required asterisk, in a horizontal auto-layout.

required.description: Shows label-required (the asterisk). Announced as "(required)"; the glyph itself is aria-hidden.

accessibility.htmlFor: Always point at the field's id.
accessibility.required: The asterisk is aria-hidden; an sr-only "(required)" carries the meaning. Set required or aria-required on the field itself as well — the label does not convey it to the accessibility tree.
accessibility.state: state is presentational. Pair Invalid with aria-invalid on the field, Disabled with the field's disabled attribute.

constraints: The parent field owns label state — never set it by hand on an instance.
Never recolour label-text or label-required on the instance; change state instead.
Do not hand-roll an asterisk in markup. Pass required.
label-required follows the field state in Disabled and Invalid; only in Default does it diverge (status/danger).
bestPractice: Required fields should be the exception. If most fields carry an asterisk, mark the optional ones instead.
Keep label text short — it is read before every field by screen readers.

openQuestions: Figma specified label-required from the start; the code shipped a bare Radix wrapper with no asterisk and no states. Every consumer invented its own marker — six copies in the prototypes, one of which rendered black. Implemented 2026-09-14; not yet verified against Figma 150:569.

Form-shared.md binds the Default asterisk to color/status/danger. The prototypes had been using color/text/invalid, which resolves to the same #ef4444 today. The spec token is now used; confirm both are intended to stay equal.

notes: state and required are separate: required controls whether the asterisk renders, state controls the colour of both parts.
Adding an explicit label-text colour is a no-op in light mode — labels already computed to #18181b by inheritance — but it makes the binding explicit and correct in dark mode.
